method.comparison: f2bf791 plus previous inventory patch versus same baseline plus prepared search and returned-value custody fix
method.processes: Three alternating sequential pairs for durable audit, three alternating sequential pairs for API timing, one separate allocation process per variant. Each process uses frozen dependencies and product/harness hashes.
method.task: A temporal investigation after a durable storage evacuation: 24 nodes, 6 racks, 1536 shards, 3 replicas, failure after 24 moves, capacity correction, stale-plan refusal, replanning, 962 moves, 3168 retained versions. 16 texts across 4 temporal views give 64 distinct full requests.
method.timed_durable_scope: Public durable execution plus consolidation. Corpus construction, cloning, full reference comparison, independent domain oracle, state inspection and replay excluded.
method.causal_scope: True read-only MemoryOwner and MemoryFactory session over retained boundaries 2 and 4, 1584 and 3168 versions. Owner open, session open, first search including preparation and 63 further searches separated. Full output hashes computed outside timing.
method.allocation_scope: tracemalloc starts after session opening in a separate process. Returned search output deleted before retained measurement. First peak and subsequent peak include allocations since tracing start; second peak includes retained projection. Not total snapshot RAM or process RSS.
method.update: New boundary creates an independent session and fully rebuilds lazily; no incremental update.
method.cold_io: OS caches not cleared. First search is not cold disk reading.
method.replay: Prefix ends immediately before session_consolidated. Every replay verifies zero transport calls and unchanged complete owner state; does not rerun the court.
method.score: Existing tokenization, six-digit rounding, positive cutoff, identity tie-break and RRF. Existing float64 semantic cosine unchanged.

profile.purpose: Profile of f2bf791 plus guarded inventory selection; instrumented durations are not benchmark samples.

limits: Measured speedup applies to this repeated-search task on this machine, not all Synapse work. Three repeats are observations, not a statistical guarantee.
First search did not speed up; owner/session opening remains about 5.6 seconds. Prepared structures trade extra per-session RAM for repeated-query speed. No process RSS reduction claimed.

All paired search events match byte for byte. Independently created public run payloads match excluding artifact_path and history_hash. Complete independently created owner states are not asserted equal; retained knowledge is unchanged and replay preserves the full state.
Search prepares the verified fixed source of its session. Mapping identity only checks pairing, not arbitrary in-place mutation freshness. New direct calls get fresh projections.
Returned search/admit aliases into pinned knowledge or history are covered; this is not a global ownership audit.
SQLite, persistent index publication, shared snapshots, compact frame, worker reference resolution and a native kernel remain separate work.
